model_annotation: This chart represents the distribution of stimulus types. The chart is divided into eight slices, each representing a different type of stimulus. The slices, listed in order of largest to smallest, are: Draft/Other (28.5%, red), Press Release (21.9%, gold), External News Article (13.1%, green), Interview (10.2%, dark blue), Organizational Report (8.8%, light purple) and Event Posting (8.8%, purple), Organizational Website (6.6%, light blue), Social Media Post (1.5%, orange), and Intra-agency news article (0.7%, light orange). No legend is present, however, the labels are written next to their corresponding slices and each slice's percentage is written in parentheses. The slices appear to be ordered in descending size.
